product.prompt: Create a photorealistic studio product visualization of the planned handmade Thinking Cap for a personal sewing project. Image 1 is the construction/shape reference: a close-fitting, short, four-panel skull-cap beanie sewn from an old fine-knit sweater, rounded crown, four subtle curved seams meeting at the top, double layered, a simple folded lower edge with NO turned-up cuff. Image 2 is ONLY a stitch motif reference: handmade barbed-wire embroidery, two closely parallel gently wandering cream threads with little tightly darned wraps at intervals and crossed X-shaped stitches on either side of each wrap. Make one complete cap, charcoal-black fine wool/cotton sweater knit with visible small knit loops and soft natural fabric imperfections. Add one continuous narrow off-white barbed-wire embroidered line circling the entire cap about 18 mm above its bottom edge. The embroidery is thread, not actual metal wire. Keep the cap modestly rounded and fitted, about 20 cm tall, without a point or pompom. Show it upright as if supported by an invisible head form, three-quarter view from slightly above eye level, entire cap visible and centered with comfortable margins. Soft broad studio light, convincing fabric depth and thread detail, neutral tones to suit a warm paper and navy handwriting website. Transparent background with no floor, no person, no hands, no text, no logos, no other objects. High quality realistic three-dimensional product photograph.

texture.prompt: A seamless repeating square PBR base-color texture of charcoal-black fine-gauge knitted sweater cloth, for a realistic 3D skull-cap beanie. Orthographic macro view directly perpendicular to a perfectly flat fabric plane. Small vertical columns of V-shaped stockinette knit loops, subtle worn wool/cotton fibres and tiny natural irregularities. The whole image is uniformly filled with approximately 65 stitch columns across, medium-fine sweater gauge. Neutral charcoal gray, the fibres visibly detailed, no colored flecks. Very flat diffuse illumination, no directional shadows, no gradients, no folds, no seams, no embroidery, no cap silhouette, no borders, no text, no perspective, no objects. Tile seamlessly on all four edges. Photorealistic material scan suitable to wrap on a 3D cap mesh. Square image.

instagram.creator: _hive.mentality_
instagram.note: Screenshot of the crossed-barb step; the cap placement is an adaptation.

animation: Actual WebGL four-panel cap geometry with the generated knit texture and handmade thread geometry. A 42 second rotation about the vertical y axis. The current still fallback is captured from the revised 3D viewer.
photo_treatment: CSS grayscale(1) contrast(.88) brightness(1.04); original tutorial frames preserved.

refinement.requested: Broader taller uneven barbs; natural sewn cap silhouette; preview at top with only preview and pause captions.
refinement.geometry: Shortened crown, oval opening, unequal panel depressions, shallow folds, slight crown lean and uneven hem. Deterministically varied stitch heights, widths, spacing, angles and wrap counts.

stitch_width_refinement: Central darned wraps vary from narrow to wide, with thread count following the width and the two crossed ends positioned beside each cluster.

brushed_finish.reference: User-selected ordinary-chalk appearance, interpreted as cured matte Paintstik-style pigment with broader coverage.
brushed_finish.implementation: Native object-space 3D pigment shader, layered broad and fine noise, pigment collecting more on raised knit loops. The finish stays fixed to the cloth through a full rotation without a UV seam.
brushed_finish.preserved: Original knit texture and bump map, natural cap geometry, varied cream embroidery, dark inner lining and bottom fold, cool tiled background, pause and drag controls.
brushed_finish.note: Visual finish study; not a physical pigment or durability test.

panel_join_refinement.construction: Subtle pressed seam channels with shallow fabric lips on each side of the join, plus narrow tonal stitching. No contrasting piping.
panel_join_refinement.photo_fit: Deep ear-covering fit with the front hem gently nudged higher above the eyebrows, blending into unchanged low side edges; subtle panel joins and monochrome crewneck portrait.
panel_join_refinement.photo_background: Plain light gray with a faint soft contour shadow; approved ear-covering fit preserved.

portrait_outline.style: Thin white contour with selective broad organic waves along the cap, shoulders and sleeves, preserving the requested thicker stroke and gap.
portrait_outline.gap: Visible gray space between the silhouette and the line, approximately 25px in the full-resolution portrait.

portrait_barb_refinement.crosses: Slightly taller crossed barbs, retaining uneven arms.
portrait_barb_refinement.middle_wraps: Taller crowded thread wraps between the crossed barbs, with irregular strand heights and varied group dimensions.
portrait_barb_refinement.preserved: Existing arrangement, thin cream thread, charcoal knit and wavy white silhouette outline.
portrait_barb_refinement.review: The earlier generation softened facial and knit detail. Retried from the sharper source, compared crop details, and removed unintended new intermediate stitch groups before selecting the replacement.

fitted_shape_refinement.geometry: Lower settled crown; earlier taper; oval head opening elongated front-to-back; flatter forehead section; subtle asymmetric crown settling and seam lean. Crown pole remains closed.
fitted_shape_refinement.material_and_camera: Reduced broad sheen and lowered the viewing angle to avoid the inflated-shell appearance. Original knit, cloudy finish, cool tiled background and slow rotation retained.
fitted_shape_refinement.stitch_refinement: Taller middle wraps with varied strand heights; crossed barbs have independently varied upper and lower arms.

portrait_framing.request: Make the figure feel photographed from a little farther away by increasing the surrounding background space.
portrait_framing.treatment: Expanded gray breathing room at the top and sides, smaller figure and scaled white contour, dark sweater continuing naturally to the bottom crop.
